comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Based on my own observations, every treasure hunt theme is specific to an era. Once the actual World Clock has been to the right era, the themes from it are available indefinitely, even after the clock moves again. Otherwise, an Adept of Age title is needed to make the TH theme available, like "Sword and Shield" currently does. If this theme has been added to the game, it's just a matter of figuring out which era it comes from.
